claims.summary: For maps A_i:U_i->W, i=1..L, between finite-dimensional spaces with nondegenerate symmetric or Hermitian forms, let r_i=rank A_i, kappa_i=r_i-rank(A_i* A_i), and d_i=rank of vertically stacked A_j* A_i for j!=i. There are orthogonal selfadjoint projections P_s summingI with sum_(i,s!=i) rank(P_s A_i)<=(L-1)sum_i min(r_i,2d_i+kappa_i)<=(L-1)(2sum_(i!=j)rank(A_j* A_i)+sum_i kappa_i).
